soundness_flags.label: def:oracle-score and thm:oracle-representer
soundness_flags.one_line: No condition ensures that W annihilates ker(O restricted to T_M), so H_j with O(H_j)=B_.j need not give a unique w_j and the stated representer need not exist.

soundness_flags.label: def:adaptation-frontier and thm:oracle-adaptation-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The q-banded truncations, likelihood p_eta, quotient chart, and derivative norms are not specified sufficiently to define chart-invariant Delta; the core itself identifies chart invariance as unresolved.

soundness_flags.label: thm:legal-lower-experiment
soundness_flags.one_line: The product prior, posterior conditioning sigma-field, and parameter-to-random-oracle map F_P(Y) are not defined, so its posterior-variance assertion is not yet a mathematical risk statement.

soundness_flags.label: thm:target-aggregation-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The balanced L-mask, dimensions of (x,1), W induced by h, and whether the displayed loss is absolute or the normalized modulus are absent, so the claimed reduction is not determined by the stated special case.

soundness_flags.label: thm:oracle-representer
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem repeats the minimization and closed-form solution already made the construction of def:oracle-score; it should be a supporting lemma after a separately stated target-identifiability condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:target-diffuseness
soundness_flags.one_line: Under the stipulated Gaussian panel, F-psi(M) is exactly Gaussian with variance s^2, so no dominant-coordinate condition is not needed for the stated Gaussian Wald conclusion.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article develops asymptotically normal estimators and confidence intervals for general linear forms from noisy partially observed low-rank matrices via double-sample debiasing and low-rank projection.
The paper studies a low-rank counterfactual matrix with a general treatment matrix and claims rate-optimal recovery of the average treatment effect for general intervention patterns.

The article studies spiked low-rank linear models, uses nuclear-norm initialization followed by rotated regressions, and establishes asymptotic-normal and semiparametrically efficient inference under its model.

The article studies deterministic MNAR panel-completion patterns and its displayed noise assumption is iid zero-mean sub-Gaussian entry noise; it explicitly notes dependent residual noise as beyond scope.
The procedure uses nuclear-norm initialization and successive least-squares factor regressions, with leave-one-out appearing only as a proof device to avoid sample splitting.
The paper proposes distribution-free regularized covariance estimation under separability and bandable covariance structure, with convergence rates and a minimax lower bound.
The paper treats low-rank-plus-sparse matrix recovery with arbitrary entrywise dependence and proves deterministic lower bounds and matching minimax risks for global recovery losses.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add an explicit target-identifiability assumption or theorem: W must annihilate ker(O restricted to T_M), then define w intrinsically as the induced functional on O(T_M).

Replace the coordinate-dependent Delta display by a fully specified finite-dimensional sieve experiment and prove its invariance under Grassmann/Stiefel chart changes before making it the iff frontier.
State the L-mask submodel completely, including N=T=2m, the concatenated loading vector, Omega, W(h), and separate absolute from s-normalized loss; then verify the displayed formula algebraically.
Demote the oracle-representer formula to a lemma and make the flagship theorem compare the repaired frontier directly with at least two named published procedures on a common observable-law subclass.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision: repair target identifiability and the chart-invariant frontier definition, then restate the L-mask reduction before advancing to Stage 0.
